# =============================================================================
# tessera-grid: resize with soft-wrap reflow   (issue #3, wave 4, milestone 0.1.0)
# crates/tessera-grid/tests/fixtures/reflow_spec.txt
#
# Evidence file for the implementer and the critic. Every row cites its source.
# It is test DATA, not a test: crates/tessera-grid/tests/reflow.rs is written from
# it (same pattern as wide.rs::fixture_cases_hold), and one script per row goes to
# crates/tessera-grid/tests/scripts/reflow/ (brief: "snapshot scripts for every
# fixture case").
#
# HOW THE EXPECTED VALUES WERE PRODUCED
#   A throw-away Python reference model (not committed; kept beside this file's
#   scratchpad as model/model.py) of the RECOMMENDED algorithm below. It contains a
#   mini Grid::put/wrap/scroll model so the `before:` blocks are what put_str would
#   build, plus the resize algorithm. It asserts after every step: every line has
#   `cols` cells, no split WIDE/SPACER pair, cursor in bounds, scrollback <= cap,
#   tab-stop vector length == cols, both screens equal in size. Every row was then
#   read through by hand against the rule cited on it. The rows are the EXPECTED
#   OUTPUT of the recommendation, not an oracle for any emulator: where an emulator
#   differs the row says so.
#
# SOURCES READ (not run; fetched 2026-10-28). "X does Y" means "X's source says Y".
#   AL  Alacritty  bbb2cbf9  alacritty_terminal/src/grid/resize.rs (grow_lines,
#                  shrink_lines, grow_columns, shrink_columns), grid/row.rs:53 shrink,
#                  term/mod.rs:655 Term::resize, :2339 TabStops::resize
#   WZ  WezTerm    e68a8ec2  term/src/screen.rs:101 rewrap_lines, :194 resize;
#                  term/src/terminalstate/mod.rs:972 TerminalState::resize;
#                  wezterm-surface/src/line/line.rs:214 Line::wrap, :1119 append_line
#   KT  kitty      89960b54  kitty/resize.c (rewrap, init_src_line, find_space_in_dest_line,
#                  update_tracked_cursors, resize_screen_buffers,
#                  resize_screen_buffer_without_rewrap), kitty/screen.c:645 screen_resize,
#                  kitty/options/definition.py:776 scrollback_fill_enlarged_window
#   XT  xterm      xterm-snapshots master  screen.c:2200 ScreenResize (no reflow),
#                  xterm.man:5326 resizeGravity ("SouthWest ... (the default)")
#   IT  iTerm2     master  sources/VT100Screen/VT100ScreenMutableState+Resizing.m
#                  (:1380 reallySetSize, :1575 alt-screen comment, :1325 saved cursor),
#                  sources/VT100/VT100Grid.m (:756 numberOfLinesUsed,
#                  :2390 restoreScreenFromLineBuffer, :2418 right margin, :2441 DWC_SKIP)
#   TS  Tessera    crates/tessera-grid/src/{grid,line,cell,tabs,scrollback}.rs at e93317e
#   brief  /private/tmp/.../scratchpad/wave4-briefs.md "Brief #3" ("lead decision N")
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ROW SYNTAX
#   A row starts with `### <ID>_<name>` and ends at the next `###`. Skip every line that
#   starts with '#'. Keys:
#     desc:             one sentence
#     layer: grid       (Grid API only; a term-level script is optional, see brief)
#     size: RxC         rows x cols BEFORE the steps (Grid::new / with_scrollback)
#     scrollback_cap:   (optional) Grid::with_scrollback cap; default 10000
#     step:             repeatable, applied in order, BEFORE the first resize
#     before: / after:  indented state blocks (grammar below); `before` is the state after
#                       the steps (derived, so a test may assert it as a sanity check)
#     resize: RxC       a Grid::resize(rows, cols) call; the `after:` block that follows is
#                       the state after THAT call (a row may have several resize/after pairs
#                       that chain on each other). `resize: 0x0` passes zeros.
#     step: leave_alt_screen   may appear between after blocks (E04)
#     cite: / note: / flags:   free text. flags: ALTERNATIVE = not the recommendation, do
#                       not assert it in the main test (use it only to document the cost).
#
#   Steps (-> Grid API)
#     put <payload>          Grid::put_str. Payload escapes: \u{H..} one scalar, and
#                            leading/trailing spaces are written \u{20}. A zero-width scalar
#                            is always written \u{..}; everything else is literal. A decoder
#                            must panic on any other escape.
#     goto R C               Grid::goto (0-based; clears pending wrap)
#     cr / lf                Grid::carriage_return / Grid::line_feed (LF keeps the column)
#     el to_end|to_start|all Grid::erase_in_line (scripts only; added after review round 1 for x01)
#     pen_bg N|none          set the pen to Style{ bg: Color::Indexed(N), ..DEFAULT } / default
#     mark_visible_row R M   push Mark M (PromptStart|CommandStart|OutputStart) on visible row R
#     save                   Grid::save_cursor (DECSC: position, pen, pending wrap)
#     enter_alt_screen / leave_alt_screen
#     region T B             Grid::set_scroll_region (cursor is NOT moved)
#     clear_tabs             Grid::clear_all_tab_stops (no cursor motion)
#     tabset C               tabs_mut().set(C) (no cursor motion)
#
#   State block (after `before:` / `after:`)
#     size: RxC  scrollback: N       Grid::rows/cols, Grid::scrollback_len
#     sb> [..]  (oldest first)        Grid::scrollback_line(i)
#     v>  [..]  (top to bottom)       Grid::visible_lines / line(r)
#     cursor: (r,c)  pending_wrap: b  saved: (r,c,b)  region: T-B
#                                     Grid::cursor, pending_wrap; the saved-cursor slot
#                                     (crate-private: assert through save/restore_cursor);
#                                     Grid::scroll_region
#     stashed_primary: p> rows ...    only while the alternate screen is active: the primary
#                                     screen's rows / cursor / pending / saved (crate-internal;
#                                     assert after leave_alt_screen or via a #[cfg(test)] hook)
#     tabs: [..]                      columns where TabStops::is_set (active screen)
#   Row syntax `[cells]` or `[cells]+` ('+' = Line::wrapped = true), then optionally
#   ` marks=A,B`. Cells are written contiguously, EXACTLY `cols` cells per row:
#       .          plain blank (' ', default style, no flags)
#       X          plain cell, literal char (no digit/./~/{/}/[/]/@/+ in fixture text)
#       X          followed by `~`: a WIDE cell then its SPACER (中~ occupies two columns)
#       {e+0301}   a CLUSTER cell: base char then `+HHHH` for each further scalar
#       {🇯+1F1F5}/W   a WIDE|CLUSTER cell (followed by ~ for its spacer)
#       _          a PAD cell: the stranded column a wrapped wide char left (CellFlags::PAD)
#       @h         suffix: cell bg is Color::Indexed(0xh), one hex digit; no suffix = default bg
#   Line::text() of a row = trailing plain blanks trimmed, spacers skipped, clusters expanded.
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RECOMMENDED ALGORITHM  (what the model implements; R-numbers are the disagreements below)
#
#   Grid::resize(rows, cols)
#   0. rows = max(rows,1), cols = max(cols,1). Same size as now => return (O(1); region, tab
#      stops, pending wrap, everything untouched). Otherwise the scroll region becomes the full
#      screen and tab stops are rebuilt (step 6).                                    (R12)
#   1. ROW STEP, at the OLD width, primary screen only (the stashed primary when the alt
#      screen is active; shares the one scrollback). No re-wrapping, O(rows).        (R2 R3)
#        grow by d:  p = min(d, scrollback_len). Pop the p newest scrollback lines to the TOP
#                    of the screen (wrapped flags and marks intact), cursor.row += p, then
#                    append d-p plain blank rows (DEFAULT pen, wrapped=false) at the BOTTOM.
#        shrink by d: t = number of trailing rows below the cursor row that are blank,
#                    unwrapped and mark-free. Drop min(d,t) rows from the bottom first, then push
#                    the remaining d - min(d,t) rows from the TOP into scrollback (evicting the
#                    oldest beyond the cap); cursor.row = max(0, cursor.row - pushed). Clear
#                    `wrapped` on the new last visible row if rows were dropped from the bottom.
#        pending_wrap and the cursor column are untouched by a row-only change.
#   2. COLUMN STEP (cols changed), primary only:
#        B = scrollback ++ visible rows (one buffer). Logical line = maximal run of rows
#        where every row but the last has wrapped=true.
#        a. cursor offset in its logical line = (sum of the widths of the logical line's
#           earlier rows) + cursor.col, +1 if pending_wrap (position AFTER the last cell of
#           the full row).
#        b. join: concatenate the rows' cells. The LAST cell of a non-final row is dropped
#           when it is a PAD cell (the stranded column, see R7; written `_` in the rows
#           below).                                                                   (R7)
#           Then trim trailing plain blanks of the whole logical line (never inner ones; BCE
#           background on them is lost).                                              (R6)
#           LEAD (after review round 1): "plain blank" for trimming and for blank rows is
#           exactly Cell::BLANK (default style) or a PAD cell; a space with any colour or
#           attribute is content. C01 is rewritten accordingly.
#        c. re-wrap greedily at the new width: a WIDE|SPACER pair (and a CLUSTER cell, which is
#           one cell) is never split; a wide pair that does not fit starts a new row and the
#           previous row is padded with a DEFAULT PAD cell (the stranded column). A wide
#           pair wider than the whole grid (cols == 1) is DROPPED.                    (R8)
#           Every row but the last of a logical line gets wrapped=true; the last gets false.
#           Marks of all rows of the line are concatenated onto the FIRST output row.
#           Rows are padded to `cols` with plain default blanks. GraphemeTable entries move
#           with their cell (re-keyed to the new column in the new Line).
#        d. cursor: offset < text length => the cell holding that glyph (a spacer maps to its
#           wide base); pending_wrap = false. Offset >= text length ("past the text"): let
#           cl = cells in the last output row and t = cl + (offset - text_len).
#             t < cols                      => (last row, t), not pending.
#             t == cols and cl == cols      => (last row, cols-1), pending ARMED (full row).  (R5)
#             otherwise                     => (last row, cols-1), not pending (clamp).       (R4)
#           LEAD (after review round 1): whenever the last row is full (cl == cols) the cursor
#           goes to (last row, cols-1) with pending ARMED, whatever t is, so the next glyph
#           wraps instead of overwriting (and never lands on a spacer without a wrap).
#        e. prune: let t_blank = blank unwrapped mark-free rows below the cursor row. If the
#           reflow made the buffer longer by e rows, drop min(e, t_blank) of them from the
#           bottom first (they would otherwise push real lines into history).
#        f. window = last `rows` rows of the new buffer (pad blank default rows at the bottom
#           if the buffer is shorter); everything before it is the new scrollback, oldest
#           evicted beyond the cap. cursor.row = max(0, cursor.row - window_start).
#           (Bottom-anchored: growing the width pulls older history into view.)       (R3)
#   3. Combined rows+cols: step 1 then step 2 (Alacritty's order, AL resize.rs:22-32).
#   4. ALTERNATE screen active: the alt screen gets NO reflow: rows follow step 1's shrink/grow
#      rule with the dropped rows DISCARDED (no history) and blank default rows appended on
#      grow; columns are cut / padded per row (a WIDE cell whose spacer is cut is blanked; its
#      cluster entry is dropped); the cursor is clamped; pending_wrap = false if cols changed.
#      The stashed primary gets steps 1-2 with ITS OWN cursor, pending wrap and saved cursor,
#      sharing the scrollback. leave_alt_screen then sees equal dimensions.           (R1)
#   5. Saved cursor (DECSC slot) of each screen: clamped to the new size only; its pending flag
#      survives only when the column count did not change.                            (R9)
#   6. Tab stops: new width w: stop[c] = old[c] for c < min(old,w); stop[c] = (c % 8 == 0) for
#      c >= old width.  Scroll region = full screen.
#   7. Pen, cursor visibility etc. are not touched. Rows added by a resize use the DEFAULT pen
#      (a resize is not an erase).
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EMULATOR DISAGREEMENTS AND THE RECOMMENDATION   (decisions for the lead are marked LEAD)
#   R1  Alternate screen. XT, KT, AL, WZ do not reflow it. iTerm2 DOES: it pushes the alt grid
#       into a line buffer and restores it at the new width (IT Resizing.m:560 and the comment at
#       :1575: "abcd/ef.." shrunk to 3 columns becomes "d../ef."). Recommend no reflow (lead
#       decision 1); the citation "iTerm2" in the brief is wrong, see CORRECTIONS. Alt rows shrink:
#       XT/AL keep the cursor row and drop bottom rows, KT keeps the top rows, WZ keeps the bottom
#       rows. Recommend the primary rule (E02) so one code path serves both.
#   R2  Rows grow. XT pulls saved lines back by default (SouthWest gravity, xterm.man:5338;
#       screen.c:2366-2412) and moves the cursor down; AL grow_lines pulls min(delta, history);
#       WZ and IT refill the whole window from history after pruning blank rows under the cursor;
#       KT does NOT pull by default (scrollback_fill_enlarged_window defaults to no).
#       Recommend XT/AL exact-delta pulling (O(rows), blank rows under the cursor stay). (D07 D08)
#   R3  Rows shrink with NON-BLANK rows below the cursor. XT/AL scroll only as far as the cursor
#       needs, so the bottom rows are dropped (lost). WZ/IT keep the content: blank rows under the
#       cursor go first, then the top rows go to history even if that pushes the cursor line off
#       the top (WZ lets the row go negative). Recommend WZ/IT (= brief lead decision 2) with the
#       cursor clamped to row 0.  LEAD: confirm (D06).
#   R4  Cursor on a blank past the text, offset >= new width. KT keeps the offset and clamps to
#       the last column (screen.c:723); AL wraps it like content onto a NEW row below
#       (resize.rs:277-281); WZ computes x / cols (a possibly nonexistent row); IT as WZ. Recommend
#       KT's clamp (a cursor never creates a row). LEAD: confirm (D02).
#   R5  Pending wrap / cursor after the last glyph of a row that is exactly full at the new width.
#       AL re-arms input_needs_wrap (resize.rs:377-381); IT and WZ put the cursor in the "right
#       margin" x == width on the same row (IT grid.m:2418-2425, WZ screen.rs:148-166), which is
#       pending wrap in all but name; KT clamps to cols-1 and LOSES the pending flag (screen.c:723),
#       so the next glyph overwrites the last cell. 3 vs 1. The brief's tie-break ("if they
#       disagree, clear it") would pick KT; recommend RE-ARM (typing after a resize must not
#       overwrite the last glyph). Flipping to "clear" changes only pending_wrap to false in
#       every row below (position is identical).  LEAD: confirm (D03 D04 and every row whose
#       cursor shows pending_wrap: true after a resize).
#   R6  Trailing blanks. KT trims never-written cells (char 0) of EVERY source row, wrapped or not
#       (resize.c:86); WZ trims only the end of the logical line, and only when it is re-wrapped
#       (line.rs:216-217, screen.rs:168); AL drops only cells that are_empty, so blanks with a
#       background colour are kept as content (row.rs:53-69); IT keeps `used height` and drops
#       unused rows. Recommend brief lead decision 4 (inner/non-final-row blanks are content,
#       trailing blanks of the logical line are trimmed and re-padded default). Note: Tessera cannot
#       tell a written space from an erased cell, KT can.
#   R7  Stranded column before a wide char. AL (LEADING_WIDE_CHAR_SPACER) and IT (DWC_SKIP) mark it
#       and remove it on join; KT leaves a blank + continuation flag; WZ leaves a short row.
#       LEAD (after verify cycle 1, replacing the earlier "drop a blank before a wide char"
#       heuristic, which erased genuine spaces at most widths): Tessera marks the column with
#       CellFlags::PAD (put_wide and the re-wrap set it; any write or erase of the cell clears
#       it) and the join drops only PAD cells, so a real space is never dropped (B03).
#   R8  Wide char into a 1-column grid. KT skips it (resize.c:225-229); WZ overflows the row. Recommend
#       skip (put_wide also refuses). The shrink -> grow round trip then loses that glyph, so the
#       proptest generator must not put wide cells in grids that visit cols == 1.
#   R9  Saved cursor. AL clamps; XT shifts its row with the scrolled lines (screen.c:2438
#       AdjustSavedCursor); KT, IT (Resizing.m:1395-1459) and WZ (stashed primary only) track it
#       through the reflow. Recommend clamp-only (brief decision 7): the initial slot (home) would
#       otherwise be dragged along with the text.  LEAD: confirm (G01).
#   R10 Marks. KT keeps the line attributes of the logical line on its first output row and resets
#       prompt_kind afterwards (resize.c:149-153); Tessera: first row, concatenated (F01).
#   R11 Tab stops. KT/AL/WZ agree: keep, extend with defaults. XT rebuilds nothing user-visible.
#   R12 Scroll region reset to full screen by every real resize: XT screen.c:2458, KT screen.c:697,
#       AL term/mod.rs:700, WZ terminalstate/mod.rs:1002. Unanimous.
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF (the spec contradicts the brief text)
#   C1  Lead decision 1 cites "xterm, iTerm2" for "the alternate screen truncates/pads". iTerm2
#       reflows the alternate screen (R1). The decision itself (no reflow) still matches xterm,
#       kitty, WezTerm and Alacritty.
#   C2  Lead decision 2: rows grow "pull lines back ... not blank rows (xterm)". xterm pulls too,
#       by default (resizeGravity SouthWest). Only kitty (default) and xterm with NorthWest gravity
#       add blank rows.
#   C3  Lead decision 3: "A cursor that lands past the new last column goes to the first cell of
#       the continuation row." True only for a cursor ON a glyph whose cell moved. A cursor just
#       after the text of a row that is exactly full has no continuation row (none exists): it is
#       pending wrap on the last column (R5). A cursor on blanks far past the text is clamped (R4).
#       "Or the position after the last cell when it sat on a blank past the text" must not mean
#       the position after the last NON-BLANK cell: a prompt "$ " with the cursor on col 2 would
#       jump left. Offsets past the text are preserved while they fit (D02).
#   C4  Lead decision 4: "BCE background on such blanks is lost; every emulator does this."
#       Alacritty keeps background-coloured trailing blanks as content (row.rs:53-69).
#   C5  Lead decision 5: "stranded column is blank with the line's pen, as put_wide does." During a
#       reflow there is no pen; recommend the default pen. And the stranded blank cannot be
#       recognised afterwards without a heuristic (R7), which decision 4 ("blanks of a wrapped line
#       are content") does not provide for.
#   C6  Done-when proptest wording "shrink(c1) -> grow(c0) reproduces the original visible text and
#       the cursor's logical position" cannot hold for arbitrary inputs. The generator must:
#       (a) keep wide cells out of grids that visit cols == 1 (R8); (b) leave the cursor ON a glyph
#       or exactly at the end of the text (a cursor parked on blanks past the text is clamped and not
#       restored, D02); (c) not exceed the scrollback cap (evicted lines never return); (d) accept
#       that BCE backgrounds on trailing blanks and the cursor row clamp of D06 are lost; (e) compare
#       Line::text() per LOGICAL line, not per row. grow(c2) -> shrink(c0) additionally needs rows
#       >= the rows the text needs at c0 or the window cuts into history (compare scrollback + screen).
#   C7  The brief's Done-when invariant "cursor in bounds" must also include: pending_wrap implies
#       cursor.col == cols-1; every wrapped row has a following row (the last row of the buffer is
#       never wrapped); region is the full screen; tab-stop vector length == cols.
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PROPERTIES TO ASSERT IN THE PROPTESTS (in addition to the rows)
#   P1  resize never panics for rows, cols in 0..=u16::MAX (use small and extreme values) on any
#       content, on both screens, with any scrollback cap including 0.
#   P2  After every resize: all lines (scrollback, screen, stashed primary) have `cols` cells; no
#       WIDE without SPACER after it / SPACER without WIDE before it; Line::graphemes keys are
#       exactly the CLUSTER cells; cursor in bounds; scrollback_len <= cap; stashed primary has the
#       same rows/cols as the active screen.
#   P3  resize(r,c) twice in a row: the second call changes nothing.
#   P4  Text conservation: concatenating Line::text of every LOGICAL line of scrollback+screen is
#       unchanged by a column change, except for lines dropped by the cap, cut off by a 1-column grid
#       (wide cells) and trailing blanks.
#   P5  Round trips as in C6.
#   P6  Row-only change: the sequence of Line::cells of scrollback ++ screen with trailing blank
#       rows removed is unchanged (rows move between scrollback and screen, nothing is rewritten),
#       and wrapped flags are untouched.
#   P7  Same-size resize is a no-op (state equality, including region and tab stops).
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ROWS

### A01_wrapped_line_split_and_rejoined
desc: a soft-wrapped line is re-split on shrink and rejoined on grow; the blank row below the cursor is pruned, not pushed to history
layer: grid
size: 3x8
step: put abcdefghijkl
  before:
    size: 3x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdefgh]+
    v>  [ijkl....]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (1,4)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x5
  after:
    size: 3x5  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcde]+
    v>  [fghij]+
    v>  [kl...]
    cursor: (2,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x8
  after:
    size: 3x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdefgh]+
    v>  [ijkl....]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (1,4)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:245-388 shrink_columns, :101-242 grow_columns
cite: WZ screen.rs:101-190 rewrap_lines (join :116-137, Line::wrap re-split :168-174)
cite: KT resize.c:81-84 (rows joined while next_char_was_wrapped), :245-266 fast_copy_src_to_dest re-splits
cite: IT VT100ScreenMutableState+Resizing.m:1380 reallySetSize (primary pushed to LineBuffer, restored at the new width)
cite: XT does not reflow (screen.c ScreenResize only reallocates)
note: Row 3 (blank, hard) lies below the cursor, so it is dropped first (lead decision 2, WZ screen.rs:216 pre-prune). After the shrink the 3-row window holds the 3 rows of the line; nothing enters scrollback. After the grow the freed row is a blank pad row at the bottom.

### A02_hard_lines_are_never_joined
desc: rows without the wrapped flag stay separate lines in both directions
layer: grid
size: 3x6
step: put abcdef
step: cr
step: lf
step: put xy
  before:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdef]
    v>  [xy....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x3
  after:
    size: 3x3  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abc]+
    v>  [def]
    v>  [xy.]
    cursor: (2,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x6
  after:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdef]
    v>  [xy....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:123-131 (should_reflow requires WRAPLINE on the last cell)
cite: WZ screen.rs:116-137 (was_wrapped gates the join)
cite: KT resize.c:81-84 prev_src_line_ended_with_wrap
cite: IT EOL_HARD vs EOL_SOFT in LineBuffer
note: "abcdef" fills the row and arms pending wrap, then CR LF: wrapped stays false (the flag is set only when the NEXT glyph arrives, Grid::wrap), so the two rows are two logical lines.

### A03_shrink_pushes_history_grow_pulls_back
desc: window is bottom-anchored: a column shrink that adds rows pushes the oldest rows to scrollback, a grow pulls them back
layer: grid
size: 3x6
step: put one
step: cr
step: lf
step: put twotwotwotwo
step: cr
step: lf
step: put three
  before:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 1
    sb> [one...]
    v>  [twotwo]+
    v>  [twotwo]
    v>  [three.]
    cursor: (2,5)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x3
  after:
    size: 3x3  scrollback: 4
    sb> [one]
    sb> [two]+
    sb> [two]+
    sb> [two]+
    v>  [two]
    v>  [thr]+
    v>  [ee.]
    cursor: (2,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x6
  after:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 1
    sb> [one...]
    v>  [twotwo]+
    v>  [twotwo]
    v>  [three.]
    cursor: (2,5)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:367-369 (new_raw truncated to the scrollback cap + lines, window is the last rows), :219-227
cite: WZ screen.rs:176-190 (prune bottom blank lines) and :314-316 (new_cursor_y = cursor_y - (len - rows))
cite: KT resize.c:100-117 linebuf_next_dest_line pushes the top row into the history buffer
cite: IT grid.m:2390-2400 restoreScreenFromLineBuffer fills from the bottom
note: Before: sb=[one], visible=[twotwo+, twotwo, three]. Shrink to 3 columns: logical lines one(1 row) twotwotwotwo(4 rows) three(2 rows) = 7 rows; the window is the last 3, so 3 more rows enter scrollback (4 total). Grow back: the 12-char line re-joins into 2 rows and "one" stays in history.

### B01_wide_char_lands_on_new_last_column
desc: a wide character that would straddle the new last column moves whole to the next row; the stranded column is a PAD cell; on grow the PAD cell is dropped again
layer: grid
size: 3x6
step: put abcd中ef
  before:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd中~]+
    v>  [ef....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x5
  after:
    size: 3x5  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd_]+
    v>  [中~ef.]
    v>  [.....]
    cursor: (1,4)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x6
  after:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd中~]+
    v>  [ef....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x7
  after:
    size: 3x7  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd中~e]+
    v>  [f......]
    v>  [.......]
    cursor: (1,1)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:289-298 and :149-158 (LEADING_WIDE_CHAR_SPACER marks the stranded column and is removed on join :136-143)
cite: WZ wezterm-surface line.rs:224 (len + cell.width() > width starts a new row; the cell is not split)
cite: KT resize.c:180-196 find_space_in_dest_line moves a multicell whole; :118 marks the previous row continued
cite: IT grid.m:2441-2447 (DWC_SKIP inferred when a soft-wrapped row is one cell short and the next row starts with a double-width char)
note: REWRITTEN after verify cycle 1: the stranded column is a PAD cell (`_`, CellFlags::PAD; the Cell size is unchanged), set by the re-wrap as put_wide sets it, and the join drops only PAD cells (the role of AL's LEADING_WIDE_CHAR_SPACER and IT's DWC_SKIP). Resizing to 7: 中 needs cols 4-5 and fits, so the 7-col result has no stranded column and the text is abcd中ef.

### B02_wide_char_stranded_blank_as_content
desc: ALTERNATIVE to B01 (lead decision 4 read literally: every wrapped-row blank is content): the stranded blank becomes a real space after one round trip

cite: AL/IT/KT keep a distinct marker for the stranded cell, so they never show the gap

Result differs from B01 at the 7-column step only: "abcd 中ef" (a gap) instead of "abcd中ef". Not recommended; included so the critic can see what the literal reading costs. Both readings satisfy the shrink(c1)->grow(c0) round-trip proptest because the original stranded blank is also a plain blank in Line::text.
flags: ALTERNATIVE

### B03_genuine_space_before_wide_char

    tabs: [0]

  after:
    size: 2x3  scrollback: 1
    sb> [abc]+
    v>  [.中~]+
    v>  [ef.]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x4
  after:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abc.]+
    v>  [中~ef]

cite: AL LEADING_WIDE_CHAR_SPACER and IT DWC_SKIP are the same explicit marker
note: REWRITTEN after verify cycle 1. Writing "abc " (4 cells, pending wrap) then 中 wraps first, leaving [abc ]+ then [中~ef]; the space is a real cell, not PAD, so no re-wrap drops it: width 3 gives [abc]+ [ 中~]+ [ef.], width 8 gives [abc 中ef] (a full row, so the cursor after the text waits on the last column with a wrap pending). The earlier heuristic (drop any blank before a wide character) erased such spaces at most widths.

### B04_cluster_cell_moves_with_its_text

size: 3x5

    v>  [fg.]

    size: 3x2  scrollback: 0

    v>  [g.]

    v>  [ab{e+0301}fg]
    v>  [.....]
    v>  [.....]

    tabs: [0]

cite: WZ line.rs:224 wrap() copies cell.str() (the whole grapheme)
cite: KT resize.c:86-100 moves a cell with its text-cache index
cite: TS grapheme.rs GraphemeTable keyed by column
note: Cluster token {e+0301} is ONE cell. Writing 5 cells fills the row (pending wrap armed, cursor pos 5). Width 3: [ab{e+0301}]+ [fg.]. Width 2: [ab]+ [{e+0301}f]+ [g.]. Back at width 5 the original cells and the armed pending wrap are restored (the cursor ends on the last cell of a full row). The GraphemeTable key of the cluster is 2, then 0, then 2 again.

### B06_wide_char_cannot_fit_one_column

### C01_hard_line_trailing_blanks_dropped_and_repadded
desc: trailing DEFAULT blanks of a hard line are trimmed on shrink and re-padded with the default pen on grow; BCE-coloured blanks are content and move with the text
layer: grid
size: 2x8
step: put ab
step: pen_bg 4
step: put \u{20}\u{20}\u{20}
step: pen_bg none
  before:
    size: 2x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab.@4.@4.@4...]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (0,5)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x4
  after:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab.@4.@4]+
    v>  [.@4...]
    cursor: (1,1)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x8
  after:
    size: 2x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab.@4.@4.@4...]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (0,5)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL: Row::shrink keeps occupied cells; blanks with a background count as occupied (row.rs:53-69)
cite: KT resize.c:86 and WZ line.rs:216-217 trim them (DIFFER)
cite: TS lead decision for #3 after round 1 (2026-10-28): only Cell::BLANK is trimmed
note: DEVIATION from the researcher's recommendation (R6/C4), decided by the lead after review round 1: only cells equal to Cell::BLANK (a space with the default style) are trailing blanks. The three bg-4 spaces (cols 2-4) are content, as in Alacritty: at 4 columns they wrap onto row 1 and the cursor keeps its place after them (offset 5 -> (1,1)); growing back rejoins them. The default blanks after them are trimmed and re-padded.

    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (2,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-3
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:221-227 (bottom anchored)
cite: WZ screen.rs:314-316
cite: IT grid.m:756-758 numberOfLinesUsed = max(cursor.y+1, last non-empty line)
note: Cursor on the empty row 2 (offset 0, blank hard line). Width 3 turns the 2-row line into 3 rows (+1 above the cursor); the blank row 3 below the cursor is pruned to pay for it, so nothing reaches scrollback and the cursor moves from row 2 to row 3.

### D06_cursor_on_row_zero_rows_shrink
desc: cursor on row 0 with non-blank rows below it: blank rows below the cursor go first, then the TOP rows are pushed to scrollback and the cursor is clamped to row 0
layer: grid
size: 5x6
step: put aa
step: cr
step: lf
step: put bb
step: cr
step: lf
step: put cc
step: goto 0 2
  before:
    size: 5x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [aa....]
    v>  [bb....]
    v>  [cc....]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (0,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-4
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x6
  after:
    size: 2x6  scrollback: 1
    sb> [aa....]
    v>  [bb....]
    v>  [cc....]
    cursor: (0,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 5x6
  after:
    size: 5x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [aa....]
    v>  [bb....]
    v>  [cc....]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-4
    tabs: [0]
cite: WZ screen.rs:216-224 (pre-prune blank rows below the cursor) and :314-316 (window = last rows; the cursor row can go negative in WZ, Tessera clamps to 0)
cite: brief lead decision 2
cite: XT screen.c:2337-2349 and AL resize.rs:84-90 DIFFER: they scroll only as far as needed to keep the CURSOR row, so "cc" would be dropped and "aa" kept
note: Rows 3 and 4 are blank and below the cursor: dropped first (2 of the 3 rows to remove). One more row must go: "aa" (the cursor row!) is pushed to history, the cursor is clamped to row 0 (now over "bb", col 2 kept). Content is preserved, the cursor is not. Grow back to 5 rows pulls "aa" and the cursor moves to row 1, still over "bb". xterm/Alacritty would keep the cursor on "aa" and LOSE "cc"; recommend following the lead (content over cursor). Only arises with non-blank rows below the cursor, which is rare outside full-screen programs.

### D10_scrollback_cap_full_columns_shrink_evicts_oldest

cite: AL resize.rs:367-369

cite: TS lead decision 8
note: Cap 3. Before: sb=[aaaaaa,bbbbbb], visible=[cccccc,dd]. The reflowed buffer has 7 rows; the window is the last 2, the 5 history candidates are aaa+ aaa bbb+ bbb ccc+, the cap keeps the 3 newest. (A cap eviction may start history in the middle of a logical line; that is fine.)

### E01_alt_screen_truncates_primary_reflows

      p>  [efgh]

Stashed primary [abcdef]+ [gh....] reflows to [abcd]+ [efgh] with its own cursor. Grow to 8: alt rows are padded with blanks, the primary rejoins. The alt screen creates no scrollback.

### G01_saved_cursor_clamped

step: save
step: goto 0 0
  before:
    size: 4x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdefgh]
    v>  [........]
    v>  [........]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (3,6,false)  region: 0-3
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x5
  after:
    size: 2x5  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcde]+
    v>  [fgh..]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (1,4,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 4x8
  after:
    size: 4x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdefgh]
    v>  [........]
    v>  [........]
    v>  [........]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (1,4,false)  region: 0-3
    tabs: [0]
resize: 4x4
  after:
    size: 4x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]+
    v>  [efgh]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (1,3,false)  region: 0-3
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x4
  after:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]+
    v>  [efgh]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (1,3,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:92-93 (clamps the saved line) and :386-387 (clamps the saved column)
cite: WZ terminalstate/mod.rs:972-1015 only re-maps the STASHED primary cursor (kept in saved_cursor while alt is active) through the rewrap and sets wrap_next = false; the live DECSC slot is otherwise untouched (never clamped): DIFFERS
cite: IT Resizing.m:1325 clampSavedCursorToScreenSize
cite: XT screen.c:2438 AdjustSavedCursor shifts the saved row with scrolled lines; kitty screen.c:723 tracks it through the rewrap: both DIFFER (content-tracking)
cite: brief lead decision 7
note: Saved (3,6,false). Clamp-only: 4x8 -> 2x5 gives (1,4); growing back does NOT restore it ((1,4) stays); then 4x4 -> (1,3) -> 2x4 stays (1,3). Content-tracking emulators (xterm, kitty, iTerm2) would move the saved position with the text; Tessera clamps only, because the initial saved slot (home, default pen) is indistinguishable from "saved at home" and would otherwise be dragged along.

### G02_saved_cursor_pending_flag_row_only_resize
desc: a row-only resize leaves cursor and saved cursor columns, pending wrap flags untouched (except row shifts)
layer: grid
size: 3x4
step: put abcd
step: save
  before:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,3)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,3,true)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 5x4
  after:
    size: 5x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,3)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,3,true)  region: 0-4
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x4
  after:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,3)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,3,true)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:114-117 and :249-252: input_needs_wrap is only touched by the COLUMN paths
cite: TS lead decision 8 (a row-only change does no re-wrapping)
note: Pending wrap armed at (0,3), saved (0,3,true). Growing rows (no history): cursor stays on row 0, pending stays armed. Shrinking to 2 rows: the two blank rows go first (cursor still row 0), pending stays armed. Row-only changes never recompute pending.

### H01_tab_stops_after_resize
desc: user tab stops below the new width are kept, user-cleared defaults stay cleared, stops beyond the old width get the default every-8 pattern
layer: grid
size: 2x20
step: clear_tabs
step: tabset 3
step: tabset 11
  before:
    size: 2x20  scrollback: 0
    v>  [....................]
    v>  [....................]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [3, 11]
resize: 2x30
  after:
    size: 2x30  scrollback: 0
    v>  [..............................]
    v>  [..............................]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [3, 11, 24]
resize: 2x10
  after:
    size: 2x10  scrollback: 0
    v>  [..........]
    v>  [..........]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [3]
resize: 2x24
  after:
    size: 2x24  scrollback: 0
    v>  [........................]
    v>  [........................]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [3, 16]
cite: KT screen.c:703-720 (init_tabstops for the new width, then memcpy of MIN(old,new) old entries)
cite: AL term/mod.rs:681-686 + TabStops::resize :2339-2347 (extend with index % 8 == 0; shrink truncates)
cite: WZ terminalstate/mod.rs:1007 tabs.resize(cols)
cite: brief lead decision 7
cite: TS tabs.rs TabStops::new / set / clear
note: Old stops: 3, 11 (all defaults cleared). 20 -> 30: keeps 3, 11; columns 20..29 get defaults => 24. 30 -> 10: keeps 3 (11 is beyond). 10 -> 24: columns 10..23 get defaults => 16 (24 would be beyond) and the kept 3. Note column 0 is NOT a stop in the first step because it was cleared.

### H02_scroll_region_reset_by_any_real_resize

    tabs: [0]

  after:
    size: 4x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 1-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 6x6
  after:
    size: 6x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-5
    tabs: [0]
resize: 6x4
  after:
    size: 6x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]

    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-5

cite: XT screen.c:2458 resetMargins

cite: AL term/mod.rs:700-701
cite: WZ terminalstate/mod.rs:1002-1003 top_and_bottom_margins = 0..rows
cite: brief lead decision 7
note: First resize is a no-op (same size): region stays 1-2. The row growth then resets to 0-5; the column change keeps full screen 0-5.

### I01_one_column_grid
desc: width 1: every glyph its own row; round trip back to a wide grid restores the text; a cursor after the last glyph is pending on column 0
layer: grid
size: 3x4
step: put abc
  before:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abc.]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,3)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x1
  after:
    size: 3x1  scrollback: 0
    v>  [a]+
    v>  [b]+
    v>  [c]
    cursor: (2,0)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x4
  after:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abc.]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (0,3)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: KT resize.c:225-229 (width-1 destination)
cite: AL: n/a (front-end enforces >= 2 columns? unverified)
cite: brief 1-column grids
note: Width 1: [a]+ [b]+ [c]. The cursor sat after "abc" (offset 3 == end of text) and the last row is full (1 of 1), so the cursor is (2,0) with pending wrap ARMED. Growing back restores [abc.] and cursor (0,3), not pending.

### I02_one_row_grid
desc: height 1: all but the cursor row go to history; grow pulls them back

step: lf
step: put bb

step: lf

  after:
    size: 1x5  scrollback: 2
    sb> [aa...]
    sb> [bb...]
    v>  [cc...]
    cursor: (0,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-0
    tabs: [0]
resize: 1x3
  after:
    size: 1x3  scrollback: 2
    sb> [aa.]
    sb> [bb.]
    v>  [cc.]
    cursor: (0,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-0
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x5
  after:
    size: 3x5  scrollback: 0
    v>  [aa...]
    v>  [bb...]
    v>  [cc...]
    cursor: (2,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: XT/AL/WZ shrink rules
cite: brief 1-row grids
note: Rows 3 -> 1: aa and bb pushed. Then 1x5 -> 1x3 changes nothing visible; back to 3 rows pulls both lines.

### I03_one_by_one_and_zero_clamp
desc: resize to 0x0 clamps to 1x1 (like Grid::new); everything but the cursor line is in scrollback; 1x1 -> 3x3 pulls back
layer: grid
size: 3x3
step: put ab
step: cr
step: lf
step: put cd
  before:
    size: 3x3  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab.]
    v>  [cd.]
    v>  [...]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 0x0
  after:
    size: 1x1  scrollback: 3
    sb> [a]+
    sb> [b]
    sb> [c]+
    v>  [d]
    cursor: (0,0)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-0
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x3
  after:
    size: 3x3  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab.]
    v>  [cd.]
    v>  [...]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
cite: KT screen.c:645-650 lines = MAX(1, lines)
cite: WZ screen.rs:142-143 size.rows.max(1)
cite: TS Grid::new clamps; brief lead decision 8
note: (0,0) means rows = 0 and cols = 0 passed to resize. cd is on the single visible cell row: width 1 splits it into [c]+ [d]; the last cell [d] is visible, "c", "ab" in history.

### J01_same_size_is_a_noop
desc: resize to the current size changes nothing: custom region, tab stops, pending wrap, wrapped flags and all
layer: grid
size: 3x6
step: put abcdefgh
step: region 1 2
step: clear_tabs
step: tabset 2
  before:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdef]+
    v>  [gh....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 1-2
    tabs: [2]
resize: 3x6
  after:
    size: 3x6  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdef]+
    v>  [gh....]
    v>  [......]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 1-2
    tabs: [2]
cite: AL term/mod.rs:662-665 early return
cite: WZ screen.rs:145-150 early return
cite: brief lead decision 8 (O(1) no-op)
note: Region stays 1-2, the lone tab stop stays 2, cursor stays (1,2). The implementation must not rebuild anything (a Grid equality / pointer-stability check is fine).

### J02_row_only_change_does_not_rewrap
desc: a row-only change never joins or splits rows: wrapped rows pulled from history keep their flags and stay as they are
layer: grid
size: 3x4
step: put abcdefghijkl
step: cr
step: lf
step: put z
  before:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 1
    sb> [abcd]+
    v>  [efgh]+
    v>  [ijkl]
    v>  [z...]
    cursor: (2,1)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 5x4
  after:
    size: 5x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcd]+
    v>  [efgh]+
    v>  [ijkl]
    v>  [z...]
    v>  [....]
    cursor: (3,1)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-4
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x4
  after:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 2
    sb> [abcd]+
    sb> [efgh]+
    v>  [ijkl]
    v>  [z...]
    cursor: (1,1)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL resize.rs:22-26 (grow_lines/shrink_lines are independent of the column paths)
cite: TS lead decision 8
note: Before: sb=[abcd]+, visible=[efgh]+ [ijkl] ... ; after grow, "abcd" returns to the top still flagged wrapped, so the logical line spans exactly the same rows.

### K01_both_dimensions_at_once
desc: rows and columns change in one call: rows first (at the old width), then columns, both bottom-anchored
layer: grid
size: 4x8
step: put one
step: cr
step: lf
step: put twotwotwotwo
step: cr
step: lf
step: put end
  before:
    size: 4x8  scrollback: 0
    v>  [one.....]
    v>  [twotwotw]+
    v>  [otwo....]
    v>  [end.....]
    cursor: (3,3)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-3
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x4
  after:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 2
    sb> [one.]
    sb> [twot]+
    v>  [wotw]+
    v>  [otwo]
    v>  [end.]
    cursor: (2,3)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-2
    tabs: [0]
resize: 5x10
  after:
    size: 5x10  scrollback: 0
    v>  [one.......]
    v>  [twotwotwot]+
    v>  [wo........]
    v>  [end.......]
    v>  [..........]
    cursor: (3,3)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-4
    tabs: [0, 8]
cite: AL resize.rs:22-32 order: lines then columns
cite: WZ screen.rs:216-257
cite: KT screen_resize reflows both with one rewrap pass
note: The final state must not depend on whether the caller sees a 3x8 intermediate state; the tests compare against the table, not against two chained calls.

### K02_logical_line_spanning_scrollback_and_screen
desc: a soft-wrapped line whose first rows are already in scrollback is rejoined as one logical line on grow
layer: grid
size: 2x4
step: put abcdefghijkl
  before:
    size: 2x4  scrollback: 1
    sb> [abcd]+
    v>  [efgh]+
    v>  [ijkl]
    cursor: (1,3)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
resize: 2x12
  after:
    size: 2x12  scrollback: 0
    v>  [abcdefghijkl]
    v>  [............]
    cursor: (0,11)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0, 8]
resize: 2x3
  after:
    size: 2x3  scrollback: 2
    sb> [abc]+
    sb> [def]+
    v>  [ghi]+
    v>  [jkl]
    cursor: (1,2)  pending_wrap: true  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-1
    tabs: [0]
cite: AL/WZ/KT/IT: scrollback and screen are one buffer
cite: brief lead decision 1
note: Before: sb=[abcd]+, visible=[efgh]+ [ijkl]. Width 12: the whole line joins to ONE row [abcdefghijkl] (pending armed, cursor (0,11)); the window is padded with a blank row below. Back to width 3: 4 rows, 2 in history.

### L01_pad_rows_use_default_pen_not_current_pen

    size: 4x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [ab..]
    v>  [....]

    v>  [....]

    tabs: [0]

    tabs: [0]

  after:
    size: 1x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [cc..]
    cursor: (0,2)  pending_wrap: false  saved: (0,0,false)  region: 0-0
    tabs: [0]
resize: 3x4
  after:
    size: 3x4  scrollback: 0
    v>  [cc..]
    v>  [....]
    v>  [....]

    tabs: [0]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT COVERED / UNVERIFIED (be honest about the edges of this file)
#   - iTerm2: read the resize driver and the grid restore (Resizing.m, VT100Grid.m). LineBuffer.m
#     (how soft/hard EOLs and DWC_SKIP are stored in history) was NOT read; the iTerm2 citations on
#     wrapping rows come from the grid side only.
#   - xterm has no reflow; its rows rules are from screen.c ScreenResize only. Its handling of the
#     alternate screen's saved-lines (savedlines while whichBuf == 1) was not traced.
#   - kitty's pager history (history.c pagerhist_rewrap_to) and multi-cell scaled text are out of
#     scope for Tessera and were skipped.
#   - A term-level script (Terminal::resize) is not specified here: Terminal::resize is a one-line
#     delegation (brief); one smoke row (A01) is enough there.
#   - Selection, display offset, hyperlinks and images are not Tessera grid state and are not modelled.
#   - The scroll-region interaction with scroll_up (history only when the region is the full screen) is
#     unchanged by a resize because the region is always reset to the full screen.
#   - Performance (brief bar) is not specified by emulators; every emulator above is O(total cells) for
#     a column change and O(rows) for a row-only change.
